methods.request: one no-follow HEAD request to each frozen official Dryad download URL, with fallback to a single no-follow GET on the same endpoint ONLY if HEAD returns 405 or 501; never read payload bytes
methods.redirect_capture: record HTTP status and Location hostname only; strip query, signed URL and user info; do not follow external locations
methods.attempts_per_source: one HEAD and at most one GET fallback for method-only HTTP 405/501

scientific_stop_rules: redirect destination host is diagnostic only; NEVER classify source schema qualified on redirect alone
do not fetch or follow redirect target and do not log signed URL or query string
if redirect target host is new, STOP_UNVERIFIED_REDIRECT_HOST; require independent provider identity verification before adding to any allowlist
if initial endpoint returns HTTP200, do not read a single payload byte; report STOP_UNEXPECTED_DIRECT_ZIP_200_UNREAD
do not substitute another dataset or independently search for a favorable source after source transport stop
do not access any biological event values, fit model, score EOG-WF endpoint, or alter Glanville record
